summary: Adds a `return_ is not None` guard so constructors/functions hinted with `-> None` skip the unit conversion, correctly fixing the AttributeError. Minimal, targeted, behaviorally correct fix with no regression to existing return-annotation handling.

issues.description: Check keys on the returned value being None rather than the annotation being NoneType. A function annotated with a real unit that happens to return None would now silently skip conversion instead of erroring; acceptable edge case but slightly broader than checking `return_annotation is None`.
Second diff hunk re-adds `quantity_input = QuantityInput.as_decorator` identically (no-op whitespace/newline artifact); harmless but unnecessary.
